titleEn: Pay Ebda Store by InstaPay (upload receipt)

undo.note: Choosing the plan writes a payment reference and is reviewed by the Ebda team; choosing again overwrites it, nothing is charged and the receipt upload stays on the billing screen.

en: How do I pay with InstaPay?
I paid but my plan is not active

steps: Billing > InstaPay > transfer > upload receipt screenshot > submit claim.
edgeCases: Claim waits for a super-admin today
Duplicate receipt / wrong amount / wrong recipient: rejected with reason
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Concurrency: preview carries the etag/version read; if data changed before apply the assistant re-previews instead of applying
Suspended store is read-only (billing suspension): writes fail, assistant must explain and link Billing
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
gaps: Super-admin confirmation required (audit gap 3 BLOCKER); AI auto-confirm with first-payment cap and daily digest NOT BUILT
